verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an MCP integration that lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use it as a search tool, and a probe confirms an official server repo at github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp. Community hands-on use confirms the server works, including Bearer-token auth on the /mcp path as an alternative to putting the key in the URL. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on setup and the exposed tools (the docs give only a one-line mention), and smoother documented secret handling, given the URL-embedded-key complaint.
